mapper.select: select student_id, total_points, level_no, day_streak, last_practice_date, week_points, week_start, update_time from spas_student_point_account where student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: insert into spas_student_point_account( student_id, total_points, level_no, day_streak, last_practice_date, week_points, week_start, update_time) values ( #{studentId}, coalesce(#{totalPoints}, 0), coalesce(#{levelNo}, 1), coalesce(#{dayStreak}, 0), #{lastPracticeDate}, coalesce(#{weekPoints}, 0), #{weekStart}, now()) on conflict (student_id) do update set total_points = excluded.total_points, level_no = excluded.level_no, day_streak = excluded.day_streak, last_practice_date = excluded.last_practice_date, week_points = excluded.week_points, week_start = excluded.week_start, update_time = now()

insert into spas_student_point_ledger( student_id, dept_id, subject_id, points, reason_code, ref_type, ref_id, biz_key, remark, create_time) values ( #{studentId}, #{deptId}, #{subjectId}, #{points}, #{reasonCode}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{bizKey}, #{remark}, now())
mapper.select: select ledger_id, student_id, dept_id, subject_id, points, reason_code, ref_type, ref_id, biz_key, remark, create_time from spas_student_point_ledger where biz_key = #{bizKey}
select coalesce(sum(points), 0) from spas_student_point_ledger where student_id = #{studentId} and create_time::date = #{day}::date
select coalesce(sum(points), 0) from spas_student_point_ledger where student_id = #{studentId} and create_time::date = #{day}::date and reason_code not in ('EXAM_CLASS_RANK', 'EXAM_CLASS_RANK_VOID')
mapper.update: insert into spas_student_point_account( student_id, total_points, level_no, day_streak, last_practice_date, week_points, week_start, update_time) values ( #{studentId}, greatest(0, #{delta}), greatest(1, (1 + floor((sqrt(1 + 8.0 * greatest(0, #{delta}) / 50.0) - 1) / 2))::int), coalesce(#{dayStreak}, 0), #{lastPracticeDate}, greatest(0, #{delta}), #{weekStart}::date, now()) on conflict (student_id) do update set total_points = greatest(0, spas_student_point_account.total_points + #{delta}), week_points = case when spas_student_point_account.week_start is distinct from excluded.week_start then greatest(0, #{delta}) else greatest(0, spas_student_point_account.week_points + #{delta}) end, week_start = excluded.week_start, level_no = greatest(1, (1 + floor((sqrt(1 + 8.0 * greatest(0, spas_student_point_account.total_points + #{delta}) / 50.0) - 1) / 2))::int), last_practice_date = coalesce(excluded.last_practice_date, spas_student_point_account.last_practice_date), day_streak = coalesce(excluded.day_streak, spas_student_point_account.day_streak), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select count(1) from spas_practice_log where student_id = #{studentId} and subject_id = #{subjectId} and practice_date = #{practiceDate}::date and coalesce(status, '0') = '0' and (proxy_flag = '0' or confirm_status = '2') and coalesce(client_type, '') <> 'checkout'

select a.student_id, a.total_points, a.level_no, a.day_streak, a.last_practice_date, a.week_points, a.week_start, a.update_time, s.student_name, s.student_no, row_number() over (order by a.total_points desc, a.update_time asc, a.student_id) as rank_no from spas_student_point_account a join spas_student s on s.student_id = a.student_id where s.dept_id = #{deptId} and coalesce(s.del_flag, '0') = '0' and coalesce(s.status, '0') = '0' and a.total_points > 0 order by a.total_points desc, a.update_time asc, a.student_id limit #{limit}

select a.student_id, a.total_points, a.level_no, a.day_streak, a.last_practice_date, a.week_points, a.week_start, a.update_time, s.student_name, s.student_no, row_number() over (order by a.week_points desc, a.update_time asc, a.student_id) as rank_no from spas_student_point_account a join spas_student s on s.student_id = a.student_id where s.dept_id = #{deptId} and coalesce(s.del_flag, '0') = '0' and coalesce(s.status, '0') = '0' and a.week_start = #{weekStart}::date and a.week_points > 0 order by a.week_points desc, a.update_time asc, a.student_id limit #{limit}

select s.student_id, coalesce(a.total_points, 0) as total_points, coalesce(a.level_no, 1) as level_no, a.day_streak, a.last_practice_date, coalesce(a.week_points, 0) as week_points, a.week_start, a.update_time, s.student_name, s.student_no, row_number() over ( order by coalesce(a.total_points, 0) desc, coalesce(a.update_time, s.create_time) asc, s.student_id ) as rank_no from spas_student s left join spas_student_point_account a on a.student_id = s.student_id where s.dept_id = #{deptId} and coalesce(s.del_flag, '0') = '0' and coalesce(s.status, '0') = '0' order by coalesce(a.total_points, 0) desc, coalesce(a.update_time, s.create_time) asc, s.student_id

select rank_no from ( select a.student_id, row_number() over (order by a.week_points desc, a.update_time asc, a.student_id) as rank_no from spas_student_point_account a join spas_student s on s.student_id = a.student_id where s.dept_id = #{deptId} and coalesce(s.del_flag, '0') = '0' and coalesce(s.status, '0') = '0' and a.week_start = #{weekStart}::date and a.week_points > 0 ) t where t.student_id = #{studentId}

select student_id as "studentId", knowledge_id as "knowledgeId", coalesce(avg_rate, weighted_rate, 0) as "avgRate" from spas_student_knowledge_stat where student_id in
#{id}

select distinct pk.knowledge_id from spas_practice_log p join spas_practice_log_knowledge pk on pk.log_id = p.log_id where p.student_id = #{studentId} and p.practice_date >= #{beginDate}::date and p.practice_date <= #{endDate}::date and coalesce(p.status, '0') = '0' and (p.proxy_flag = '0' or p.confirm_status = '2')

select l.ledger_id, l.student_id, l.dept_id, l.subject_id, l.points, l.reason_code, l.ref_type, l.ref_id, l.biz_key, l.remark, l.create_time from spas_student_point_ledger l where l.reason_code = 'EXAM_CLASS_RANK' and l.ref_type = 'exam' and l.ref_id = #{examId}::varchar and l.points > 0 and not exists ( select 1 from spas_student_point_ledger v where v.reason_code = 'EXAM_CLASS_RANK_VOID' and v.biz_key = ('EXAM_CLASS_RANK_VOID:' || #{examId}::varchar || ':' || l.student_id::varchar || ':' || l.ledger_id::varchar) ) order by l.ledger_id asc
